title: EvoAl memory model: iteration
description: Written as iteration-<number>.json for each iteration. Iteration 0 is the initial population. Every individual created or kept in this iteration is listed once in 'individuals'; steps and ranks refer to them by id. Relationship targets may refer to individuals of earlier iterations.

steps.description: Intermediate steps of the iteration (e.g. recombination, mutation, selection) in execution order.

oneOf.description: UnorderedIterationStep: the result is a bag of individuals.

ranks.description: The final individuals of the iteration (survivors), ranked.

bestSoFar.description: The id of the best individual found up to and including this iteration. It may belong to an earlier iteration. Missing if the algorithm does not track the best individual.

metrics.description: Values of the iteration metrics (scope 'iteration') at the end of the iteration.
